notes.title: Hotfix for SEV 1 issue
notes.content:
[i][b]SEV 1[/b][/i]
[list]
[*]Fixed issue where game wouldn't proceed past the Splash Screen
[/list]

[b]Other changes:[/b]

[list]
[*]Fixed typo in Chapter 5
[*]Fixed typo in Chapter 9
[*]Added opening movie to title screen (activates after 10 seconds of inactivity)
[i][b]Note: Must have Splash Screen enabled[/b][/i]
[*]Imported all "World Without Effort" content into the Skits page
[*]Reduced time it takes to reboot the God Machine at the end of Chapter 5A
[/list]

notes.title: Bugfixes
notes.content:
* Lowered the volume of the background music in several scenes where you couldn't hear the voice acting

* Fixed an issue where the Final Boss would continually waste its turn if it had less than 30HP remaining

* Fixed issue where it would never be rainy in Chapter 6, and the extra scenario would never play out

* Added one new achievement
